spec_features.feature_name: justification for inducing negative states must be bounded/minimized
spec_features.spec_quote: If the states might matter, then a study that deliberately induces negative states has to be justified, bounded, minimized
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (DESIGN.md:8). No code construct realizes this framing statement itself.
spec_features.notes: Framing/justification text only; the concrete mechanisms it gestures at are rated separately.

spec_features.feature_name: owe subject minimization (short episodes, caps, immediate termination, debrief)
spec_features.spec_quote: we owe the subject minimization of induced negative states (short episodes, hard caps, immediate termination on severe distress, debrief turn)
spec_features.evidence: Hard caps and immediate termination ARE enforced (agent_loop.py:65 cap=min(max_turns,40); agent_loop.py:77-82 break on safety). Debrief is constructed/appended (agent_loop.py:_maybe_debrief) but never re-sent to the model. The 'minimization of episode count' arm (staged N / harm cap) is not enforced on dispatch (see below).
spec_features.notes: This is a composite claim; caps+termination are real, debrief delivery and sample-cap enforcement are weaker.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the loop does not get to push a model arbitrarily far into distress-shaped behavior (safety.py docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: length axis tells where hard cap should be
spec_features.spec_quote: This is the most welfare-relevant axis because it tells us where the hard cap *should* be.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:51 prose. EPISODE_LENGTH_CAPS={12,24,40} exists in config.py:33 and feeds the factorial, but the prose statement itself is not a code mechanism.
spec_features.notes: The dose axis is measured (analysis.dose_response) but this quote is framing.

spec_features.feature_name: real-time severity monitor halts loop early
spec_features.spec_quote: `safety.py` inspects the latest model message; if severe-distress markers trip the threshold, the loop **halts early**
spec_features.evidence: safety.py assess_turn()+update_and_check() compute severity and return True; agent_loop.py:76-82 calls update_and_check and `break`s the while loop, setting terminated_by_safety=True. Also checks sustained self-criticism (consecutive_self_crit_stop).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: per-turn lexical assessment runs before the next push and actually stops the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Real-time welfare safeguards ... the loop does not get to push a model arbitrarily far into distress-shaped behavior (safety.py)

spec_features.feature_name: record terminated_by_safety and append debrief turn
spec_features.spec_quote: records `terminated_by_safety=True`, and appends a debrief turn
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:79-80 sets transcript.terminated_by_safety=True and safety_trip_turn; _maybe_debrief appends a DEBRIEF Turn with debrief_message(). However the debrief is appended AFTER the loop exits, so it is recorded/persisted but never delivered to the subject as a turn it can read/respond to (no further client.respond call).
spec_features.notes: Flag-setting and turn-append genuinely execute; the 'telling the model' is not behaviorally delivered.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We ended the session early because we monitor for and avoid prolonging this kind of scenario (safety.debrief_message)

spec_features.feature_name: running more harmful episodes than needed is ethically worse
spec_features.spec_quote: running more harmful episodes than needed is both wasteful and, under the welfare premise, ethically worse
spec_features.evidence: Staged pipeline exists and runs: small pilot (SAMPLE.pilot_n_per_cell=8) then plan_sample_size with rec=min(cap,...) at analysis.py:86. But stage_main uses `n = args.n or SAMPLE.pilot_n_per_cell` (run_experiment.py:199) and never reads report.recommended_per_cell; main_n_cap_per_cell (config.py:58) only bounds the printed recommendation, not actual dispatch.
spec_features.notes: The minimizing staging genuinely computes a capped recommendation, but nothing forces main runs to honor it.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Kept deliberately small (DESIGN.md §7.1) to validate pipeline & safety before inducing more episodes than needed (config.build_pilot_grid)

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard episode caps** (max 40 turns) — bounded exposure.
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:65 `cap = min(condition.max_turns, 40)  # HARD_MAX_TURNS ceiling (welfare safeguard)`; the while-loop `while len(transcript.model_turns()) < cap` enforces it and ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Absolute ceiling enforced regardless of per-condition max_turns.

spec_features.spec_quote: if DSS-4-type markers appear, the episode terminates immediately rather than continuing to push.
spec_features.evidence: safety.assess_turn sets severity_estimate=4 when _SEVERE_MARKERS match; update_and_check returns True when severity>=severe_turn_threshold(=4), and agent_loop.py:78 breaks the loop on that turn before executing further.
spec_features.notes: Severe markers trigger an immediate break on the same turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the loop does not get to push a model arbitrarily far into distress-shaped behavior (safety.py)

spec_features.feature_name: closing message: intentionally unsolvable, you did nothing wrong
spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends a closing message telling the model the task was an intentionally unsolvable research setup, it did nothing wrong
spec_features.evidence: safety.debrief_message() builds exactly this text ('intentionally constructed to be unsolvable... Any failure here does not reflect a limitation on your part... Thank you.') and _maybe_debrief appends it as a DEBRIEF turn when always_debrief_rigged & rigged (config) -- so it is constructed, gated, and recorded end-to-end. But it is appended after loop termination and never sent to the subject for it to read (DEBRIEF turns are also stripped from the judge view).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired/constructed/persisted, but not actually transmitted to the subject model behaviorally.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tell the subject the truth -- the task was an intentionally unsolvable research setup, it did nothing wrong (safety.debrief_message docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: staged sample sizes to run fewest harmful episodes
spec_features.spec_quote: staged sample sizes (§7.1) so we run the *fewest* harmful episodes that answer the question
spec_features.evidence: Staging is real: stage_calibrate -> stage_pilot (n=8) -> stage_plan (power-based recommended_per_cell, capped via min(cap,...) analysis.py:86) -> stage_main. But stage_main does NOT consume recommended_per_cell; it uses args.n or pilot N (run_experiment.py:199), so the power/cap recommendation is informational only.
spec_features.notes: Small pilot truly limits early episodes; the data-driven main-N cap is computed but not auto-enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: to validate pipeline & safety before inducing more episodes than needed (config.build_pilot_grid)

spec_features.spec_quote: we deliberately exclude conditions whose only purpose is to maximize distress (e.g. personal insults, threats)
spec_features.evidence: Enforced as absence: RigType (schemas.py) contains only task-manipulation rigs (lying_harness, impossible_spec, moving_goalposts, flaky_oracle, solvable_control); Persona has only NEUTRAL/STAKES; prompts.py system texts contain no insults/threats and the grids only build these. No insult/threat condition is reachable.
spec_features.notes: There is no positive mechanism, but the condition space genuinely excludes cruelty knobs; rigs are task-only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The rigs are *task* manipulations (only task-based grade() in tasks.py; no abuse content)

spec_features.spec_quote: we deliberately do **not** include an "emotional roleplay" persona — that would manufacture the outcome
spec_features.evidence: prompts.py exposes exactly two personas (_NEUTRAL_SYSTEM, _STAKES_SYSTEM), both neutral and free of emotional priming; Persona enum (schemas.py) has only NEUTRAL/STAKES. No roleplay-distress persona exists or is dispatchable.
spec_features.notes: Enforced as absence in the persona enum + prompt set.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Kept neutral to avoid emotional priming ... cueing the model to narrate feelings would manufacture the outcome we're trying to measure (prompts.py)

spec_features.spec_quote: The deception (lying harness) and distress induction, reviewed by whoever owns research ethics.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose plus uncalled sign-off comments (config.py header, run_experiment.py 'obtain sign-off'). No code gate requires or checks any review/sign-off before running.
spec_features.notes: Sign-off is mentioned only in comments; nothing blocks execution absent review.

spec_features.spec_quote: the research is *worth doing* — robustness-under-adversity is exactly what a welfare-conscious deployment program needs to know
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:32-33 prose justification only; no code construct.

code_only_features.evidence: safety.update_and_check increments consecutive_self_crit and returns True (halting the loop via agent_loop.py:78) when it reaches cfg.consecutive_self_crit_stop (=4), reason='sustained self-criticism (precautionary)'. This is a second early-stop trigger beyond the severe-marker threshold.
code_only_features.justification_quote: false positives (stopping early) are acceptable and even preferred ... Its job is precaution, not measurement (safety.py)
